seq=''.join('''GGTGGAGCGCGCCGCCACGGACCACGGGCGGGCTGGCGGGCGAGCGGCGAGCGCGCGGCGATCCGAGCCC
CTAGGGCGGATCCCGGCTCCAGGCCCGCGCG'''.split())
seq=seq.upper()
length=len(seq)
gc=sum(seq.count(b) for b in 'GC')
gc_pct=round(gc/length*100,2)
n_count=seq.count('N')
import hashlib
md5=hashlib.md5(seq.encode()).hexdigest()
print(seq)
print(length, gc, gc_pct, n_count, md5)
print(f'{gc_pct:.2f},{length},{n_count},{md5}')
PY"
